title: Auto Feed Me
body: # How it works? This plugin adds the ability to feed your player by placing your consumable items within a UI, when running the command /afm open, you can place any food-related items inside, the plugin will automatically feed your player whenever the hunger bar decreases. ![interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/134403a0a481417d4c304f4ba182b77cf29cdff7.png) After adding some food items, you can enable the plugin by running /afm on or off. This is extremely useful if you are more focused on building/pvp/exploring and want to forget completely about having to eat every time you get hungry or life decreases. # Features: - Survivor-friendly. - The auto-feed feature will be disabled by default on the first install. Each player has to manually enable it by running /afm on, only the first time. - Automatically saves all the food items you store within the UI and also the toggle status. So when you leave and come back to the server dont need to re-enable the plugin. - The UI will ONLY accept consumable items. If you place a non-consumable item inside, it will return it to your inventory on close, or will drop it to the ground. # Installation: - Drop the .jar file into your plugins folder, restart the server. Bye!
